place.description: Town or location (type a name; the region is shown)

strike.description: Strike a timer off the board

cleanup.description: Remove the struck timers from the board

repair.description: Repost the board messages from the saved timers

settings.description: Show or change the settings of this channel's board

thresholds.description: When to alert before expiry, for example 6h, 2h, 30m

alertRoleAction.description: Add or remove that role, or clear all roles

duplicates.description: What to do when an identical active timer exists

restrictChanges.description: Only the owner and officers can strike or refresh a timer

maxActive.description: Maximum number of active timers on the board

purgeAfter.description: Delete struck or expired timers after this many hours (0 = never)

resetOnNewWar.description: Empty the board when a new war starts

regionEmoji.description: Icon before the region in the board (an emoji, or default)

locationEmoji.description: Icon before the town in the board (an emoji, or default)

data.exportHelp: Download a JSON file of the data stored for this server: settings, allowed roles, audit records, boards and timers, history, alerts, technical identifiers and application logs. Audit records, history and application logs are retained for 30 days. Todolists stay in Discord. Legacy external logs and operator backups are not included.
data.exportReady: 📥 Here is your server’s data. This file is visible only to you. It includes Discord identifiers: keep it private. No settings were changed.
data.exportTooLarge: The complete export exceeds the {{limitMb}} MB upload limit. No partial file was sent. Contact the PICKET operator to obtain your data.
data.cancelled: The scheduled deletion has been cancelled. PICKET is active again.
data.nothingScheduled: No deletion is scheduled for this server.

panel.title: PICKET · Server settings
panel.homeHelp: Choose the language and modules for your server. Each change takes effect immediately.
panel.expired: This panel has expired. Open /picket settings again.
panel.owner: This panel belongs to another user. Open /picket settings yourself.
panel.auto: Automatic — follows each user’s Discord language
panel.languageHelp: **Automatic** follows each person’s Discord language, then the server language, then English. Choose a **fixed language** so PICKET uses the same language for everyone.
panel.timersHelp: Track deadlines and receive alerts from your boards.
panel.todolistsHelp: Share task lists to check off in Discord.
panel.disableHelp:
Interactions and background processing for this module will stop.

**Existing data is retained.**
panel.reserved: The time zone is saved for future functionality and has no operational effect today.
panel.auditHelp: Publishes configuration changes, todolist creations, timer creations and removals, and alert acknowledgements. Todolist contents and countdown restarts are excluded.
panel.readOnly: Only administrators can change these permissions.
panel.restrictHelp: Add a member role before removing @everyone if members should retain access.
panel.everyoneHelp: Every member of this server will be able to use member commands. Officer access remains restricted.
panel.deletionHelp:
Deletion **suspends PICKET immediately**. After the configured retention period, server configuration, access roles, timers, history and audit records are **permanently erased**.

Discord messages, including todolists, are **not automatically deleted**.
panel.suspended: PICKET is suspended. Data deletion is scheduled for <t:{{timestamp}}:F> (<t:{{timestamp}}:R>).
panel.recovery: Only a server administrator can cancel deletion. Other settings are unavailable during suspension.
panel.legacy: Commands have moved to this panel. No old command arguments were applied.
panel.statusReserved: Time zone: preconfiguration only. War log: coming soon.

audit.paused: ⚠️ Audit publication is paused: the bot cannot use the configured channel. An officer can test and resume it in Settings → Advanced.
audit.queued: A test message is queued in the audit channel. Publication has resumed.
audit.blocked: The bot cannot use this channel. Check that it belongs to this server and that PICKET can View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links.
audit.unavailable: Discord is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
